newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end firm amid interest rate optimism.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end firm amid interest rate optimism.

text.p: Chile blue chips closed above the psychologically important 100-point barrier Friday amid optimism that interest rates will fall by year-end, said traders.
The bolsa could open softer Monday as investors cash in gains struck during the weeklong rally, they said.
"There could be a technical adjustment, although the underlying mood is positive," said Jorge Elton, a trader at brokerage Copinvest.
The selective IPSA index ended up 1.14 percent at 101.01 points. The general IGPA index gained 0.59 percent to 5,527.48.
